controls.result: An in-memory prior router delivered the Bili event with a QQ ID. The repaired production router rejected it before attribution, then accepted a valid QQ event with the same message ID.
controls.note: The temporary mutation was removed from the permanent test before the final test:all run. That test now exercises the production router only.

developmentNote: The first attempt to add the meter-wait regression returned a number from the fixture store callback. That fixture error was corrected before the reproduced assertion failure retained here.
